purpose: Promote only KPHC 2019 sub-county observations that pass one of two frozen documented geography routes (strict geometry equivalence or a pinned unique subcounty-to-constituency PCode crosswalk) plus complete-county reconciliation into constituency-level Local-54 series.

source.report: 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census Volume IV — Distribution of Population by Socio-Economic Characteristics

required_gates: pinned census extraction tables verified by Git blob SHA
one approved geography route: frozen strict geometry equivalence OR pinned unique secondary PCode crosswalk
weighted source sub-county aggregation reproduces county control within 0.15 percentage points

publication.rationale: The numeric value is published by KNBS for the source sub-county. KDA exposes it at constituency level only after a documented geography crosswalk and complete-county reconciliation pass; the geographic transformation remains visible and the value is never described as a direct KNBS constituency publication.

strict_geometry.thresholds: IoU >= 0.98; source coverage >= 0.99; constituency coverage >= 0.99; one-to-one

secondary_pcode_crosswalk.rule: source KPHC sub-county PCode must map to exactly one external constituency/Admin-2 PCode, which must resolve uniquely to the KDA constituency registry
secondary_pcode_crosswalk.limitation: secondary documented crosswalk, not an official KNBS or IEBC boundary instrument; therefore Class C presentation remains mandatory
